title: Task sync SSH transport without shell interpolation
outcome: Task sync SSH transport without shell interpolation
acceptance: The bounded Git runner supports fetch and push over SSH remotes using the user's existing SSH agent or keys, with no prompts (batch mode) and no shell interpolation of Engram-supplied values, under the same process-tree job, deadline and output bounds as HTTPS, with tests
Unsupported SSH configurations (custom core.sshCommand with arbitrary scripts, interactive authentication, unknown ssh variants) refuse explicitly with guidance
Local fixtures prove logic only; a real SSH remote check is listed in the cross-machine test plan rather than claimed
